cs.t: I bought a Rosewill mechanical keyboard[1] (Cherry MX) about a year ago. People claim it's the best bang for your buck. A few weeks ago, I spilled tea on it. While it was drying, I switched back to my Logitech K310 washable keyboard[2]. My enjoyment and productivity on the K310 are exactly the same, and I won't be switching back to the mechanical keyboard because it's not waterproof. YMMV. 1.  https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00UBQZPXK/  2.  https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B008D1JRIO/
